name: AI Agent Framework
shortDescription: Visual builder for LLM agents based on Flowise, with local models through Ollama and PostgreSQL storage
description:
A self-hosted agent builder based on [Flowise](https://github.com/FlowiseAI/Flowise) 3.1. You design chatflows and agentflows in a drag-and-drop editor: agents that call tools, keep conversation memory and hand work to other agents. Every flow is also available over a REST API, protected by API keys.

The stack runs three containers: Flowise, [Ollama](https://ollama.com) for local models (`llama3.2:3b` by default, a small model that supports tool calling), and PostgreSQL as the Flowise database. Model providers with an API key (OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral and others) can be added in the Flowise UI instead of or next to Ollama.

Secure defaults: every secret (database password, encryption key, token secrets) must be set before the first start, the owner account is created automatically from your `.env` so the instance cannot be claimed by the first visitor, and the ports are bound to `127.0.0.1`. Deploy with Docker Compose, Helm (HelmForge Flowise chart and the otwld Ollama chart), Terraform with the Docker provider, or Terraform on a single AWS EC2 instance.
requirements: Docker Engine with Docker Compose v2
4 CPU cores and 8 GB RAM for the default 3B model on CPU (16 GB recommended)
About 25 GB free disk: the images are about 5 GB to download and about 13 GB unpacked, llama3.2:3b adds about 2 GB
Optional: NVIDIA GPU with the NVIDIA Container Toolkit (compose.gpu.yaml)

envVariables.name: FLOWISE_PORT
envVariables.description: Host port of the Flowise UI and API (bound to 127.0.0.1)

envVariables.name: OLLAMA_PORT
envVariables.description: Host port of the Ollama API (bound to 127.0.0.1)

envVariables.name: FLOWISE_ADMIN_NAME
envVariables.description: Display name of the owner account

envVariables.name: FLOWISE_ADMIN_EMAIL
envVariables.description: Login email of the owner account, created on first start

envVariables.name: FLOWISE_ADMIN_PASSWORD
envVariables.description: Owner password: 8-128 characters with upper and lower case, a digit and a special character

envVariables.name: FLOWISE_SECRETKEY_OVERWRITE
envVariables.description: Encryption key for stored credentials (openssl rand -hex 32). Keep it stable

envVariables.name: TOKEN_HASH_SECRET
envVariables.description: Hashes password-reset and invite tokens (openssl rand -hex 32)

envVariables.name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
envVariables.description: Password of the flowise PostgreSQL user (openssl rand -hex 32)

envVariables.name: APP_URL
envVariables.description: Public URL of Flowise; an https:// URL turns on secure cookies

envVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL
envVariables.description: error, warn, info, verbose or debug

envVariables.name: DISABLE_FLOWISE_TELEMETRY
envVariables.description: Set to false to send anonymous usage data to FlowiseAI

envVariables.name: OLLAMA_MODEL
envVariables.description: Model pulled on start; use one with tool calling for agents

envVariables.name: OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE
envVariables.description: How long a model stays loaded after the last request
